sources.title: USACE engineer describes Salang Tunnel repair design
sources.use: Text only. Approximately 1.6 miles; variable curved tube with constrictions about 20 ft wide by 16 ft high. Approaches have long concrete protective galleries. Overhead ventilation fans, dim lamps, drainage and layered road surfacing. Original Soviet plans were unavailable even to USACE; nominal section and repeated hidden bays must be labeled estimates. No original survey or photographs from this article adopted.

phaseBasis: Named Army photographs from 2009 and 2011 show the same portal type. Represent 2011; do not claim current 2026 appearance. Current OSM centerlines provide approximate geographic registration of the historical bore/galleries. Post-2013/2023 work is outside this appearance. Neither exact historical route shape nor every hidden section is certified.
